page_title: ATM 2-1 ALA | Atletico Madrid v Alaves 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) earns the yellow card.

90+5' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Antonio Sivera pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Tomas Conechny (Alaves) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' It's a yellow card for Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Manu Sanchez as he is replaced by Stoichkov (Alaves).
87' Referee Victor Garcia has finally had enough of Diego Simeone and brandishes a yellow card at him!

86' 2 - 1 Goal! Rodrigo de Paul shows great vision to find Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
85' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Carlos Martin is replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
85' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Aleksandar Sedlar.
83' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
80' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:3.
79' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Antonio Sivera into right side of the goal.
76' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
75' Luis Garcia Plaza appears to have said too much and referee Victor Garcia comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
75' The Atl. Madrid players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
75' Referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Atl. Madrid. Let’s see what happens!
74' Surely that's handball by one of the Alaves players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
74' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.
73' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Kike Garcia will be replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
72' That will be all from Jon Guridi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Moussa Diarra (Alaves).
72' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) will replace Koke.
70' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
69' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

69' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Antonio Sivera anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
68' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.

68' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
68' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ander Guevara (Alaves). Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick.
67' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
64' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) replaces Samuel Lino.
61' It's a nice effort by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Antonio Sivera. Easy save.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch for Angel Correa.

59' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
58' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
55' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
54' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
53' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
52' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
49' The free kick from long range, taken by Atl. Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. That's a free kick to Atl. Madrid.
47' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
47' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle.
46' Here is a change. Marcos Llorente is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
46' Javi Galan comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Yellow card. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Antonio Sivera was alert and the score remains the same.
45' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
43' Victor Garcia interrupts the game. One of the players from Alaves won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
41' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
40' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

36' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Antonio Sivera.
36' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.
33' Koke (Atl. Madrid) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera was alert and made a comfortable save.
33' A player from Atl. Madrid commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
32' One of the Alaves players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
30' Kike Garcia (Alaves) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
29' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) and blew his whistle.
28' A crossfield pass from Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates.
27' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
25' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
23' Victor Garcia has a clear sight and sees a foul from Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 70:30.
19' A great pass puts Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
19' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
17' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
14' Half-chance! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
12' Jan Oblak displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Carlos Vicente (Alaves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
12' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Jon Guridi (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jan Oblak into left side of the goal.
7' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
6' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY to Alaves!
6' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
5' A lofted cross from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross in and finds Marcos Llorente inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
2' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
1' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
1' Carlos Martin (Alaves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Victor Garcia signals.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
